units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“这誓谈它则甚？

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, said, "What is there to say about such vows?

units.source_text: 过去之罪，早已被天风吹散了。”

en.t: The sins of the past have long since been scattered by the winds of heaven."

units.source_text: 说时神态风流潇洒。

en.t: As he spoke, his bearing was elegant and graceful.

units.source_text: 宣旨同情他，打趣地说道：“如此说来，

en.t: The court messenger felt sympathy for him and said teasingly, "In that case,

units.source_text: ‘此誓神明不要听’了！”

en.t: 'May the gods not hear this vow,' then!"

units.source_text: 一本正经的槿姬听了这些话很不高兴。

en.t: The solemn Princess Asagao was very displeased to hear such words.

units.source_text: 这位小姐性情向来古板，年纪越大，越发谨慎小心了，

en.t: This lady had always been rigid by nature, and as she grew older she became still more cautious and reserved,

units.source_text: 连答话也懒得多说。

en.t: so that she could scarcely be bothered to say much even in reply.

units.source_text: 众侍女看了都替她着急。

en.t: Seeing this, all the ladies-in-waiting grew anxious on her behalf.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣扫兴地说：“想不到我此来变成了调戏！”

en.t: Disappointed, Genji, the Inner Minister, said, "I never thought my visit would turn into a jest!"

units.source_text: 长叹一声，便起身告辞。

en.t: He gave a long sigh, then rose and took his leave.

units.source_text: 一面走出去，一面言道：“唉，年纪一大，便受人奚落。

en.t: As he went out, he said, "Ah, once one grows old, one is mocked by others.

units.source_text: 我为了小姐，憔悴至此。

en.t: For your sake, my lady, I have wasted away to this state.

units.source_text: 小姐却待我如此冷淡，

en.t: Yet you treat me with such coldness,

units.source_text: 使我连‘请君出看憔悴身’也吟不得了！”

en.t: that I cannot even recite, 'Please come out and see this wasted body of mine'!"

units.source_text: 众侍女照例极口赞誉源氏内大臣的美貌。

en.t: As usual, the ladies-in-waiting lavishly praised the beauty of Genji, the Inner Minister.

units.source_text: 此时秋夜澄碧如水，众侍女听了风吹落叶之声，

en.t: At that moment the autumn night was clear and blue as water, and the ladies-in-waiting heard the sound of wind blowing through the fallen leaves,

units.source_text: 都回想起以前住在贺茂神社时饶有风趣的光景，

en.t: and all recalled the charming scenes from the time when they had lived at Kamo Shrine,

units.source_text: 那时源氏公子来信求爱，有时可喜，有时可叹。

en.t: when Prince Genji sent letters seeking love, sometimes delighting them and sometimes making them sigh.

units.source_text: 她们历历回思此等旧事，相与共话。

en.t: They vividly remembered these old events and spoke of them together.
